newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Hun Sen tells world to stay out of Cambodia affair.
newsitem.headline: Hun Sen tells world to stay out of Cambodia affair.

text.p: Cambodia's powerful Second Prime Minister Hun Sen on Tuesday told the international community to stay out of Cambodia's affairs and said people should be left alone to sort out their problems.
Hun Sen, who ousted his co-premier Prince Norodom Ranariddh earlier this week, said the international community should not put any pressure on Cambodia.

"I would like to appeal to the international community to understand the internal situation in Cambodia," he said in a speech broadcast on television. "Let the Cambodian people solve this problem by themselves without any interference and external pressure."
He said acting Head of State, Chea Sim, would write a letter to the Secretary General of the United Nations to explain the current situation in his country.
Fighting erupted between Hun Sen's forces and those loyal to First Prime Minister Ranariddh in Phnom Penh on Saturday.

Hun Sen announced the following day that Ranariddh, who was in France when the fighting broke out, was no longer the country's first premier. Looting and violence has gripped the Cambodian capital since.
